questions.question: An article is sold at a profit of 13(1)/(4)\%. Had it been sold for ₹76.70 more, the profit would have been 16(1)/(5)\%. The cost price of the article is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

An article is sold at a profit of 13(1)/(4)\%

Had it been sold for ₹76.70 more, the profit would have been 16(1)/(5)\%

**Concept used:**

SP = CP + Profit

**Calculation:**

Let the CP be 100x.

So, SP = 113.25x [13(1)/(4)\% = 13.25%]

New, SP = 116.2x [16(1)/(5)\% = 16.2%]

According to the question,

116.2x - 113.25x = 76.7

⇒ 2.95x = 76.7

⇒ x = 76.7/2.95 = 26

So CP = 100 × 26

⇒ Rs. 2600

**∴ Cost price is Rs. 2600**

questions.question: 5 men and 6 women can earn ₹10,500 in 6 days. 8 men and 12 women can earn ₹24,800 in 8 days. In how many days will 7 men and 10 women earn ₹26,500?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

5 men and 6 women can earn ₹10,500 in 6 days. 

8 men and 12 women can earn ₹24,800 in 8 days. 

**Calculation:**

5 men and 6 women can earn Rs. 10500 in 6 days

5 men and 6 women can earn Rs. 1750 in 1 day

10 men and 12 women can earn Rs. 3500 in 1 day

Again,

8 men and 12 women can earn Rs. 24800 in 8 days

8 men and 12 women can earn Rs. 3100 in 1 day

So, 2 men can earn in 1 day = (3500 - 3100) = 400

1 man can earn Rs. 200 in 1 day

1 woman can earn in 1 day = (1750 - 1000)/6 = 125

So,

7 men and 10 women earn in 1 day = 200 × 7 + 10 × 125

⇒ 1400 + 1250

⇒ 2650

So, they will earn 26500 in 26500/2650 = 10 days

**∴ Required time is 10 days**

questions.question: The selling price of 28 articles is the same as the cost price of 18 articles. Find the profit or loss percentage.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The selling price of 28 articles is the same as the cost price of 18 articles

**Concept used:**

Loss % = {(CP - SP)/CP} × 100

where, CP = Cost price SP = Selling price

**Calculation:**

CP of 18 article = SP of 28 articles

⇒ CP/SP = 14/9

So here a loss is incurred

Loss % = {(14 - 9)/14} × 100

⇒ 5/14 × 100

⇒ 35(5)/(7)\%

**∴ The loss percent is 35(5)/(7)\%**

questions.question: When the numerator of a fraction is increased by 25% and the denominator is increased by 31(1)/(4)\%, it becomes (5)/({14)}. Find the fraction.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Increase in numerator = 25%

Increase in denominator = 31(1)/(4)\%

New value = (5)/({14)}

**Concept used:**

x% increase = (100 + x)/100

**Calculation:**

Let the original fraction be x/y.

25% = 1/4

31(1)/(4)\% = 5/16

Change in numerator = 5/4

Change in denominator = 21/16 

⇒ (x × 5/4)/(y × 21/16) = 5/14

⇒ (5x/4)/(21y/16) = 5/14

⇒ 20x/21y = 5/14

⇒ x/y = 3/8 

**∴ The original value of the fraction is 3/8.**

questions.question: The average age of two persons 5 years ago was 7.5 years. Find their average age after 5 years.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average age of two persons 5 years ago was 7.5 years

**Concept used:**

Average = Sum of elements/No. of elements

**Calculation:**

Total age of them 5 years ago was 7.5 × 2 = 15

Total age after 5 years from present = 15 + 10 × 2 [5 years + 5 years for two persons]

⇒ 35

Average = 35/2 = 17.5

**∴ Their average age after 5 years is 17.5**

questions.question: A train takes 1 hour and 12 minutes to cover a certain distance at a speed of 90 km/h. If the speed is increased by 40%, then how long will it take to cover (7)/(3) of the distance?
questions.solution:

Speed of the train = 90 km/h

Time = 1 hour and 12 minutes

**Concept used:**

Distance = Speed × time

**Calculation:**

1 hour 12 minutes = 1.2 hours [12/60 = 0.2]

So, distance = 1.2 × 90

⇒ 108 km

Now,

7/3 of the distance = 252 km

New speed = 90 × 7/5 = 126 km/h

Time = 252/126 = 2 hours

**∴ Required time is 2 hours**

questions.question:
The mean of 70 items was 32. Later, it was discovered that two items were misread as 64 and 28 instead of 46 and 81.

The correct mean is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The mean of 70 items was 32

Misread numbers are 64 and 28 instead of 46 and 81

**Concept used:**

Mean = Sum of elements/No. of elements

**Calculation:**

Total of all numbers = 70 × 32

⇒ 2240

Actual total of all numbers = 2240 - 64 - 28 + 46 + 81

⇒ 2275

Actual mean = 2275/70 = 32.5

**∴ The correct mean is 32.5**

questions.question: The present ages of a mother and her son are in the ratio of 6 : 1. When the son becomes as old as his mother now, then the ratio of his father's age to his mother's age is 13 : 11. When the son becomes as old as his father now, then the sum of the ages of the father and son will be 115 years. The present age of the father is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The present ages of a mother and her son are in the ratio of 6 : 1

When the son becomes as old as his mother now, then the ratio of his father's age to his mother's age is 13 : 11

When the son becomes as old as his father now, then the sum of the ages of the father and son will be 115 years

**Calculation:**

Let the present age of mother and son be 6x and x

and father's age be y

Now,

According to the question,

After 5x years

Mother = 6x + 5x = 11x 

Father = y + 5x

Now

y + 5x/11x = 13/11

⇒ y = 8x

So, the father's age is 8x years

Again,

After 7x years

Father = 8x + 7x = 15x

Son = x + 7x = 8x

15x + 8x = 115 years

23x = 115 years

x = 115/23 = 5 years

So the age of the father is 8 × 5 = 40 years

**∴ The present age of the father is 40 years**

questions.question: A dealer marked the price of an item at 50% above the cost price. He allowed two successive discounts of 30% and 25% to a particular customer. As a result, he incurred a loss of ₹850. At what price did he sell the item to the said customer?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Marked Price = 50% above the Cost Price

Loss = Rs. 850 

Successive Discounts = 30% and 25%

**Formula Used:**

Net Discount = Discount₁ + Discount₂ – [(Discount₁ × Discount₂)/100]

**Calculation:**

Let the CP be Rs. 100x

Then, MP = Rs. 150x

Net Discount = 30 + 25 – [(30 × 25)/100]

⇒ 47.5%

So,

47.5% of 150x = 47.5/100 × 150x

⇒ 71.25x

SP = 150x – 71.25x

⇒ 78.75x

 = 100x – 78.75x = Rs.21.25x

According to the given question,

21.25x = 850

⇒ x = 40

⇒ 78.75x = 40 × 78.75 = 3150

**∴ He sold it at Rs. 3150**

questions.question: Three numbers are coprime to each other such that the product of the first two numbers is 88 and that of the last two numbers is 165. The sum of all three numbers is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Product of the first two numbers is 88 and that of the last two numbers is 165

**Concept used:**

Co-prime numbers have no prime factors in common so when expressed as fraction there will be no simplification

**Calculation:**

Let the numbers be A, B and C respectively

A × B = 88 and B × C = 165

(A × B)/(B × C) = 88/165

A/C = 8/15

So,

A = 8 and C = 15

B = 88/A

⇒ 11

Sum of the numbers = 8 + 11 + 15 = 34

**∴ The sum of all three numbers is 34**

questions.question: A man walked at a speed of 6km/h from point A to B, and came back from point B to A at a speed of 10 km/h. Find the ratio of the time taken by the man in walking from A to B to that from B to A.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Speed for A to B = 6 km/h

Speed for B to A = 10 km/h

**Concept used:**

When the distance is constant, then speed is inversely proportional to time.

**Calculation:**

Ratio of speed = 6 : 10

⇒ 3 : 5

According to the concept,

Ratio of time = 5 : 3

**∴ The ratio of the time taken by the man in walking from A to B to that from B to A is 5 : 3**
